changes.comment: A command that waits for a daemon restart now says what it waits for and why the daemon restarts, for every reason and on a pipe too, and repeats the line with the time waited every 25 seconds. A rushx script that waits for another request's restart says so, and the lines and admission failures of rushx-client begin with "rushx-client:". Once the command asks rushd to cancel the request, it no longer writes that the request waits.
